[[File:HeroofTatooine.png|thumb|right|250px|Hero of Tatooine sculpture]]
'''Hero of Tatooine''' was a title bestowed by a [[Unidentified Rodian hermit|Rodian hermit]] upon an anonymous [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] who demonstrated heroism while performing several [[Quest of the Hero of Tatooine|tasks]] to help the people of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:TMotH" />

==History==
{{Main|Quest of the Hero of Tatooine}}
{{Quote|It is my belief that the galaxy is in dire need of heroes--those individuals who have demonstrated beyond doubt their dedication to the path of light. You are brash and young, but perhaps one day you will become a hero and bring light to this darkened place.|A Rodian hermit|<ref name="SWG:TMotH" />}}
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a spacer who explored a [[Squill Cave|cave]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] encountered a old [[Unidentified Rodian hermit|Rodian hermit]] living there. As both agreed that the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] had brought darkness to the galaxy, the hermit proposed four specific tasks to the spacer that would allow them to become a hero through helping the inhabitants of Tatooine.<ref name="SWG:TMotH" />

The spacer then completed the four [[Quest of the Hero of Tatooine|tasks]], displaying intelligence to deduce who was the target of a puzzled [[Tearfin|bounty hunter]], honor by refusing to be corrupted by [[Sand slum pirates|pirates]], courage by killing a ferocious [[Bladeback boar/Legends|bladeback boar]], and altruism by assisting a moisture farmer by rescuing his family from the [[Sennex]] slavers. After all tasks were completed, the adventurer returned to the hermit who declared them the Hero of Tatooine. He awarded them with four "trophies" &mdash; the [[Mark of Intellect]], the [[Mark of Honor]], the [[Mark of Courage]], and the [[Mark of Altruism]] &mdash; that formed a unique spherical sculpture, and the [[Mark of the Hero]], a ring which was believed to be able to bring its bearer back from death.<ref name="SWG:TMotH" />
